talk.source: CMU 19_08 (conversation, explain with hand gestures), gestures damped 50% towards CMU 77_02 standing pose, procedural jaw

sit_ground.notes: pelvis on the ground at the origin, back towards -Z (place the origin ~0.25 m in front of a wall)

lie_supine.notes: body lies on its back on the ground plane (back at y~0), head towards -Z, feet towards +Z; offset the root to put it on a stretcher

kneel_work.notes: kneeling on the right knee, hands working ~0.45 m in front of the origin at ground level

carry_walk.notes: rear stretcher bearer: hands hold handles ~0.3 m in front of the hips, ~0.95 m above ground

limp_walk.source: CMU 91_16 (Limp), arm swing damped towards CMU 77_02 standing pose

point.notes: one-shot: points forward-right with the right index finger (~0.7-1.9 s hold)

crouch_cover.source: hand-keyed (IK squat, hands over helmet, breathing/trembling)
crouch_cover.notes: deep squat, head tucked, both hands on top of the helmet, breathing/trembling loop

lie_sleep.notes: asleep on the LEFT side on the ground plane, head towards -Z, face towards +X, knees drawn up, head pillowed on the left forearm; the body extends ~0.75 m along -Z and +-0.4 m in X from the origin

sit_huddle.notes: pelvis on the ground ~0.18 m behind the origin, knees drawn up, arms wrapped round the shins, head bowed, slow rocking

dig.notes: standing shovelling cycle (thrust, lever, lift, toss to the character's right); hands grip an implied shovel handle (no prop), blade point ~0.55 m in front of the origin

carry_box.notes: walk carrying a box (~0.35 m wide) at chest height, hands on its sides ~0.31 m in front of the hips

kneel_listen.source: hand-keyed (IK, kneeling, hand cupped to the ear)
kneel_listen.notes: kneeling on the right knee, head bowed and turned (right ear down), right hand cupped to the ear, left hand on the rubble ~0.45 m in front

wave.notes: one-shot: raises the right arm and waves (~1.8 Hz) between ~0.75 s and ~2.8 s, starts/ends in the idle pose

talk_worried.source: CMU 77_02 (standing) base + hand-keyed hand-wringing/gesture (IK), procedural jaw
talk_worried.notes: anxious conversation: hands wringing in front of the stomach, one open-palm gesture per loop, shoulders raised, quick breathing, procedural jaw
